recentItems.title: Delhi-NCR Air Quality Worsens: GRAP Stage 1 Imposed, Vehicle Checks To Get Stricter | Breaking News
recentItems.description:
Delhi-NCR Air Quality Worsens: GRAP Stage 1 Imposed, Vehicle Checks To Get Stricter | Breaking News

Delhi-NCR has invoked Stage 1 of the Graded Response Action Plan (GRAP) after the Air Quality Index (AQI) reached 245, marking the season's first day of poor air quality.

Authorities are stepping up pollution-control measures across the National Capital Region, including dust suppression, stricter checks on polluting vehicles and enforcement of construction-related restrictions. Agencies are also expected to strengthen road cleaning and action against open waste burning.
